items.title: Native backend: a local closure that awaits is emitted as a spawned task while its call sites still await it, so cargo refuses the build
items.discussion: found by lane kit-wire (Order 58, 2026-11-13) wiring the clipboard keys; worked around in the examples with top-level helpers (`held_text`, `spare_screen`); repro `scripts/integration/sweeps/order58/repros/b743-awaiting-local-closure.vl` (also with `sleep(1)` in place of `clipboard_text()`)
items.area: crates/vilan-rust/src/lib.rs (closure emission, async inference at call sites)
items.body: `let board = |what: str| { let held = clipboard_text(); print(..); }; board("first");` in `fun main()`: the closure's body awaits, the emitter makes it a spawned task, and the call site awaits the call as if it answered a future. Decide which side is right (a closure that awaits is an async closure whose call awaits, as a function's is) and pin on both backends in `native_differential`. RELATED, not reproduced in isolation: `.width(..).padding(..)` on a `TextInput` built inside a `when` closure in the todo example's `check` came out `async` and was refused; look for it while fixing this one, in `vilan/examples/ui-todo/main.vl`'s `spare_screen` helper, which exists only as the workaround.

items.title: `std::ui` after the kit wiring: what F176, F177 and the clipboard keys leave open or decided in lane
items.body: DECIDED IN LANE, owner may overrule: the blink is 530 ms on and 530 ms off, only while the input, enabled, has the focus in a focused window (an unfocused window shows the caret steadily); auto-scroll steps every 100 ms within 25 dp of the edge, 50 ms from 25 dp, 33 ms from 50 dp, 25 ms from 75 dp; pasted line breaks become spaces in the single-line input and `\n` in the text area; Ctrl+Insert, Shift+Insert and Shift+Delete also copy, paste and cut; copy and cut with an empty selection do nothing and bubble; a `Both`-axis scroll is a grid with one max-content cell; the new PUBLIC names `std::ui::advance_clock(by)` (stops and steps the timers' clock, for recorded listings), `std::ui::timer_count()`, `TextInput::caret_shown()`, `TextArea::caret_shown()`, `std::gfx::use_memory_clipboard()` (an in-memory clipboard behind the same host worker, for `--check` modes). QUESTION worth the owner's eye: three of those are test seams in the public surface (`advance_clock`, `timer_count`, `use_memory_clipboard`); they could move under a `std::ui::testing` module before a release documents them. HOST FIX that rode along, affecting real use: a key pressed with Ctrl or Super also typed its letter (winit's `KeyEvent::text` leaves Ctrl in), so Ctrl+A selected all and then replaced it with `a`; such a key now types nothing unless Alt is also held (Windows reports AltGr as Ctrl+Alt): reasoned from winit's documentation, NOT run on Windows. NOT VERIFIED: Windows and macOS at run time; under xvfb a focused input now draws a frame every 530 ms, by design.
